headline: GetBack Affair Returns to Court; Two People Face Up to 25 Years in Prison
summary: Warsaw's Regional Prosecutor's Office filed the 16th indictment in the GetBack S.A. case. It concerns alleged damage exceeding 1.3 billion zlotys, with two people facing up to 25 years in prison.
why: GetBack was a Polish debt-collection and lending company, and the case is a major test of accountability in the country's corporate finance sector.
